question: Find the area of a regular hexagon (in cm²) with sides of length 6 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of **Regular Hexagon** = 6 × Area of one **Equilateral Triangle**

Area = 6 × (√3 ÷ 4) × side²

Area = 1.5 × √3 × 6²

Area = 1.5 × √3 × 36

Area = 54√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 54√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** side (a) = 6 cm

**Formula Used:** Area of Regular Hexagon = [3√3 ÷ 2] × a²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f61aa6f74a17cc436ebf7fc36c79568fc3df6c98aa35f338f6dd9967ac293709.png] 

⇒ Area = [3 × √3 ÷ 2] × (6)²

⇒ Area = [3 × √3 ÷ 2] × 36

⇒ Area = 3 × √3 × 18

⇒ Area = 54√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 54√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interior Angles of Hexagon

Each **interior angle** of a regular hexagon is 120° and the sum of all interior angles is 720°.

Perimeter of Regular Hexagon

The **perimeter** is calculated as P = 6 × a, where a is the side length.

Inradius and Circumradius

For side a, the **circumradius** (R) = a and the **inradius** (r) = (√3 ÷ 2) × a.</p
